description: Lightweight initiative entity — the parent container for a fleet deliverable spine. A cross-repo bet, feature area, or goal that groups related work artifacts. Artifacts carry initiative: <id> as a nullable FK. Roadmaps attach to an initiative as one kind of initiative; a cross-repo bet with no formal roadmap is still a first-class initiative. Stored per-initiative in state/initiatives/<id>.yaml. Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-07-03-fleet-deliverable-spine-identity-and-facets.md § D2

id.description: Stable initiative identifier (e.g. 'example-fleet-pro-launch'). Used as the FK value in artifact frontmatter initiative: fields. Kebab-case; unique across the repo.

label.description: Business-legible display name (e.g. 'Example-Fleet Pro Launch'). Shown on the CEO board as the parent grouping label.

owner.description: EM or workstream identifier owning this initiative. Nullable — may be unassigned at inception.

status.description: Initiative lifecycle status. active=in flight; paused=temporarily blocked; shipped=done; abandoned=cancelled.

target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the intended completion, or null. null means ongoing / burn-down shape (no fixed end — work continues until the initiative is abandoned or shipped organically). A dated value means completion shape — the initiative has a concrete deadline and progress is tracked toward it. Spec backlink: docs/plans/2026-07-04-initiative-govern-sweep-prioritize-doe-d.md § C1 (AC2)

goals.description: Optional many-to-many list of goal-ids this initiative contributes to. A goal-id pointing nowhere is a soft tag — no referential enforcement. Absent or empty means no goal linkage declared.
